title: Weeknote #2016
summary: St Jude update, a bug fix on Lens, and some fun links
content:
Our St Jude Fundraiser has blasted past $5k, and I had to make a an Obsidian base to keep track of all the drawings I need to do. The first one arrived yesterday and if you want one for yourself there's one slot left right now. You can donate here.

Thanks to Melanie pointing it out, I fixed a bug in Lens where it would catch SVG title elements when it shouldn't.

It’s not for me but the detail on this Wallace and Gromit set is fantastic.

Matt reviewed the Ulanzi D100H. I love buttons and knobs.

This project by Chris generates an Internet Phone Book 88x31 badge for you. I had my own version I'd made but the animated one from here is way better so I swapped it out.

There's a proposal for a .well-known URL for changing passwords which seems so obvious now I see it.

How to write a short story in five sentences — it does exactly what it says it will and nothing more.

There is nothing better than a pencil manufacturing video and this one about how Blackwings are made is great.

An art gallery using a slop poster is so stupid I can't even.

Terence Eden has a post about verifying ActivityPub signatures which was a colossal ballache when I did it previously.

Visual design rules you can safely follow every time. I love articles like this with simple and understandable actions I can take to make my sites better.
